name: 100% Pure Canned Pumpkin Puree (Unspiced)
whyItWorks: Pure canned pumpkin is steam-cooked and pureed into an ultra-smooth consistency. It is rich in soluble fiber that absorbs excess fluid in watery diarrhea without scraping inflamed tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy 100% pure pumpkin (such as Libby's), NOT sweetened pumpkin pie mix. Stir into oatmeal, blend into a gentle soup with chicken broth, or mix with white rice.
watchOuts: Do not confuse with Canned Pumpkin Pie Mix, which contains added sugar, cloves, allspice, and irritating spices.
